collection.name: Software & Bots
collection.description: Application runtimes, Discord bots, APIs and microservices
collection.author: Midnight Team

shard.name: Generic Java
shard.description: Run any standard executable Java application, Spring Boot microservice, or standalone JAR.
shard.author: Midnight Team
shard.installScript:
#!/bin/bash
# Generic Java Application Installation Script for Midnight Panel
set -e
apk add --no-cache curl ca-certificates

cd /mnt/server
if [ ! -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ]; then
    echo "Downloading JAR from ${DOWNLOAD_URL}..."
    curl -o "${JARFILE}" -fSL "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
fi

echo "Installation complete! Please upload your JAR file if not downloaded automatically."

variables.name: Executable JAR File
variables.description: The name of the JAR file to execute.

variables.name: JVM Arguments
variables.description: Custom flags passed directly to the java virtual machine (e.g. -Dserver.port={{SERVER_PORT}}).

variables.name: Application Arguments
variables.description: Arguments passed to the application main method.

variables.name: Download URL
variables.description: Optional direct URL to download the JAR file during creation.
